title: Add a retrying price client with injected fetcher and sleep
prompt:
Add a price client as a new feature directory src/main/features/prices. Its index.ts exports the functions fetchPrices and describePrice, and nothing else.

fetchPrices(symbols: readonly string[], deps: PriceDeps): Promise<readonly PriceResult[]> looks up every symbol and resolves to one result per symbol, in the order of symbols (an empty list resolves to []). All symbols are looked up concurrently, so a slow symbol never delays the first request of another. The deps parameter has the type { readonly fetcher: (symbol: string) => Promise<{ readonly status: number; readonly body: string }>; readonly sleep: (ms: number) => Promise<void>; readonly options: { readonly maxAttempts: number; readonly baseDelayMs: number } }. The feature does no I/O of its own: it calls deps.fetcher(symbol) (one argument) for each request and waits only through deps.sleep.

Each result is { readonly kind: 'ok'; readonly symbol: string; readonly cents: number } or { readonly kind: 'failed'; readonly symbol: string; readonly reason: 'not-found' | 'rate-limited' | 'server-error' | 'network' | 'bad-body' }. cents is an integer number of cents.

Per symbol, up to options.maxAttempts requests are made in total (maxAttempts is a positive integer; 1 means no retry):
- A status from 200 to 299 is a reply to parse. The body is a price in plain decimal notation: digits with no sign, no leading zeros (except a lone 0) and an optional fraction of one or two digits, such as '19.99', '5', '0.07' or '5.1'. Surrounding whitespace, such as a trailing newline, is ignored. Anything else ('', 'abc', '-1.50', '1e2', '19.999', '.5', '007', '"19.99"', 'null') is a failure with reason 'bad-body', and so is a price whose value in cents is above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. A bad body is never retried. Prices are money: '19.99' is exactly 1999 cents.
- Status 429 is retried; when attempts run out the reason is 'rate-limited'. A status from 500 to 599 is retried; the reason is 'server-error'. A fetcher call that rejects, with anything, is retried; the reason is 'network'. When a later attempt fails differently, the reason comes from the last attempt.
- Any other status from 400 to 499 is not retried and is a failure with reason 'not-found'. Any status outside 200 to 599 is not retried and is a failure with reason 'server-error'.
- Before attempt n + 1, wait with deps.sleep(options.baseDelayMs * 2 ** (n - 1)) milliseconds, once, with that exact value. There is no wait before the first attempt and none after the last one. A symbol that succeeds on a retry is ok.

describePrice(result: <that result type>): string returns the output line for a result, without a newline: an ok result is '<symbol> <dollars>.<two-digit cents>' (1999 cents for AAPL is 'AAPL 19.99'; 5 cents is 'AAPL 0.05'; 100 cents is 'AAPL 1.00'), a failed result is '<symbol> failed: <reason>' ('ZZZZ failed: not-found').

Wire it into src/main/composition-root.ts as a new exported async function pricesMain(symbols: readonly string[]): Promise<void>, next to main. It calls fetchPrices with the global fetch and a real setTimeout-based sleep, then writes one line per symbol to process.stdout, in order, each line being describePrice of its result followed by '\n'. The fetcher requests exactly fetch(`https://prices.example.com/quotes/${encodeURIComponent(symbol)}`) (a single string argument) and returns { status: response.status, body: await response.text() }. The default options are maxAttempts 3 and baseDelayMs 500, so a symbol that keeps failing waits 500 ms and then 1000 ms. Do not change the greeting feature.

Add tests for every status class, every failure reason, the exact delays requested from sleep and the attempt counts in test/prices.test.ts. Run nitpicker-gate until it exits 0.
